caption:
Take mine. The bigger pot

"I need a bigger pot." "Take mine." It left the counter and was steaming at its new place before the sentence ended.

A pot that sits in the cupboard all week is the one a neighbor needs on Saturday.

For whoever lends the big pot to whoever needs it.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a long counter on the right and a soup pot with a lid on it. A brick-red block figure with narrowed eyes says I need a bigger pot. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers take mine, and the pot hops down off the counter and lands next to the red one, where it starts to steam. The red one's eyes go wide and says ...perfect. thanks. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me lending the big pot.
